q: A user's PC has the IP address 169.254.10.22 and can't reach the internet. What is the MOST likely cause?
choices: The PC could not reach a DHCP server
why: 169.254.x.x is an APIPA address, self-assigned when DHCP fails.

q: Which port does RDP use by default?
why: RDP = TCP 3389.

q: Which protocol and port retrieves email while keeping it synced on the server?
why: IMAP (143) syncs mail on the server; POP3 downloads it.

q: A user can ping 8.8.8.8 but cannot browse to www.example.com. Which service is MOST likely failing?
why: IP connectivity works, name resolution does not — DNS.

q: Which 2.4 GHz channels do not overlap?
why: 1, 6 and 11 are the non-overlapping 2.4 GHz channels in North America.

q: Which tool locates a specific cable at a patch panel?
why: A toner probe sends a tone down the cable so you can trace it.

q: Which RAID level provides fault tolerance using parity with a minimum of three drives?
why: RAID 5 = striping with parity, min 3 drives.

q: Toner rubs off printed pages from a laser printer. Which component is MOST likely faulty?
why: The fuser melts toner onto the paper with heat and pressure.

q: A PC's clock resets every time it is unplugged. What should be replaced?
why: The CMOS battery keeps time and settings without power.

q: Which component is required for Windows 11 and stores encryption keys in hardware?
why: Windows 11 requires TPM 2.0.

q: Which is a Type 1 hypervisor?
why: ESXi runs directly on hardware (bare metal).

q: A company rents virtual servers and manages its own OS and apps. Which cloud model is this?
why: IaaS gives you infrastructure; you manage OS and up.

q: Which cloud characteristic lets resources scale up and down automatically with demand?
why: Rapid elasticity = scale automatically.

q: A company wants to remotely wipe lost corporate phones and enforce PIN policies. What should it deploy?
why: Mobile Device Management enforces policies and remote wipe.

q: A smartphone's case is bulging. What should the technician do FIRST?
choices: Stop using it and replace the battery safely
why: A swollen battery is a fire hazard.

q: According to CompTIA methodology, what is the step AFTER establishing a theory of probable cause?
choices: Test the theory to determine the cause
why: Identify → Theory → Test → Plan → Verify → Document.

q: A technician's theory is not confirmed after testing. What should they do next?
choices: Establish a new theory or escalate
why: If not confirmed, re-establish a new theory or escalate.

q: A desktop makes a loud clicking noise and runs slowly. What should the technician do FIRST?
why: Clicking = failing HDD; protect data first.

q: Which Windows edition can NOT join an Active Directory domain?
why: Home cannot join a domain or use gpedit.

q: Which file system should be used on a USB drive that must hold a 10 GB file and work on Windows and macOS?
why: FAT32 has a 4 GB file limit; exFAT is cross-platform with large files.

q: Which command repairs corrupted Windows system files?
why: System File Checker repairs protected OS files.

q: Which Linux command changes file permissions?
why: chmod changes mode/permissions; chown changes owner.

q: Which macOS feature provides automatic backups?
why: Time Machine = backup.

q: Which tool would you use to view application crash logs in Windows?
why: Event Viewer (eventvwr.msc) holds application/system logs.

q: An attacker calls a user pretending to be the help desk and asks for their password. What is this?
why: Voice phishing = vishing.

q: Which wireless security protocol is the MOST secure?
why: WPA3 with SAE is strongest.

q: A folder has share permission Read and NTFS permission Full Control. What is the effective permission over the network?
why: When combined, the most restrictive applies.

q: Which data destruction method does NOT work on SSDs?
why: Degaussing only affects magnetic media.

q: Malware that hides deep in the OS and may require reimaging is a:
why: Rootkits hide in the OS/kernel.

q: What document proves a third party securely destroyed drives?
why: A certificate of destruction.

q: In the malware removal process, what step comes right after quarantining the infected system?
why: Investigate → Quarantine → Disable System Restore → Remediate → Schedule → Enable Restore → Educate.

q: What is the LAST step of the malware removal process?
why: Step 7 is educating the end user.

q: A user's browser keeps redirecting to unknown search pages. What is the MOST likely cause?
why: Redirects are a classic malware symptom.

q: An Android phone has unexpectedly high data usage and new unknown apps. What is MOST likely?
why: High data usage + unknown apps = likely malware.

q: Which backup type requires the last full backup plus ALL subsequent backups to restore?
why: Incrementals only hold changes since the last backup of any type.

q: Where would a technician find proper disposal instructions for a toner cartridge?
why: Safety Data Sheets cover handling and disposal.

q: Which group approves changes in a formal change management process?
why: The Change Advisory Board.

q: Which file extension indicates a PowerShell script?
why: .ps1 = PowerShell.

q: Which device protects a server from short power outages?
why: A UPS provides battery backup.

q: A customer is explaining a problem. What should the technician do?
choices: Use technical jargon to show expertise
why: Active listening, no interrupting, no jargon.
